title: Cleanup epan headers that should be part of dissection
description:
Take several of the header files from /epan and move them (and the data they want to share) to the dissector directory.  Many dissectors already have header files where the data can be added, others create a new dissector header file just for sharing constants related to the protocol (typically for dissector tables)
Trying to remove "dissector specific" knowledge from the /epan directory
